nodes.label: Besta Solar Stock (multi-boutique stock & POS application)
nodes.rationale: Centralizes products, stock, sales (POS), clients, suppliers, purchases, inter-shop transfers, users, reports and audit log for Besta Solar; amounts in CFA franc (XOF).
nodes.norm_label: besta solar stock (multi-boutique stock & pos application)

nodes.label: Supabase Backend (PostgreSQL + Auth + RLS + Edge Functions)
nodes.norm_label: supabase backend (postgresql + auth + rls + edge functions)

nodes.label: Row Level Security Policies
nodes.rationale: SQL migrations in supabase/migrations/ create tables, RLS policies and functions; RLS enforces per-role and per-shop data access at the database level.

nodes.label: bootstrap-admin Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Account creation is reserved to admins, creating a chicken-and-egg problem for the first account; bootstrap-admin runs server-side with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and only allows creation while no administrator exists yet.

nodes.label: Admin Role
nodes.rationale: Full access; manages users and shops.

nodes.label: Manager Role
nodes.rationale: Operational management restricted to the manager's own shop.

nodes.label: Point of Sale (POS) Module
nodes.rationale: Fast checkout with product search, discounts and multiple payment methods.

nodes.label: index.html Application Shell
nodes.rationale: French-language PWA-capable shell (theme-color #f57c0b, apple-touch-icon, mobile-web-app-capable) that mounts the React app into #root and loads /src/main.tsx as ES module entry.

nodes.label: Inline Error Capture Script (error / unhandledrejection)
nodes.rationale: Displays any load-time error on screen inside #root so failures can be diagnosed without opening the browser console — important for mobile/PWA usage.

nodes.label: Fallback Loading Marker in #root
nodes.rationale: Static 'Chargement…' marker visible until React takes over #root; if it stays displayed it signals that JavaScript is not executing (plus a noscript notice).
